plain: Two models argue opposite answers and a weaker judge, human or model, picks the argument that holds up.
eli5: Two kids argue about who broke the vase, and the parent only has to decide whose story holds together.
technical: Irving et al. (2018): a zero-sum game in which two copies of a model argue for competing answers and a judge decides; the hope is that refuting a lie is easier than finding one, so judging stays feasible as debaters get stronger.
